lena (People Ops): Heads up 1) Noah handed in his resignation this morning; last day 2026-06-11 (Thu). 2) Need to coordinate benefits COBRA, equipment return, and legal hold on customer dataset he was working on.

ryan (Manager): Confirmed. We'll plan KT sessions week of 6/1. Noah will finish the current sprint task but won't be assigned new tickets.

noah (Eng): I can do two 1hr KT sessions: Tue 6/2 11am PT and Wed 6/3 3pm PT. Also I have a company SIM and parking permit to return.

chloe (Benefits): Benefits summary: active through 06/11/2026 11:59pm PT. COBRA notice will be emailed to personal email within 3 business days. COBRA election window is 60 days from the date of notice. FSA: run-out period for claims ends 9/30/2026; remind him to submit expenses.

lena (People Ops): Noah, please confirm preferred personal email for benefits + 401k distribution info and whether you'd like the 401k rollover packet mailed or electronic.

noah (Eng): Personal email = noah.saito.personal@gmail.com. Rollover packet electronic is fine. Also my 401k provider needs a termination code; I can forward details to HR.

mike (IT): Equipment / access plan:
- Request return label for laptop and company SIM by 6/12 if remote
- Deactivate Okta + Slack at 18:00 PT on 6/11
- Revoke API tokens and personal AWS console keys at deactivation time
- Remove from Google Workspace groups and GCP IAM roles
Return items: laptop, power brick, YubiKey (if issued), parking tag, SIM.

hana (Security): Security note: Noah is on the customer-data project flagged for legal hold (case 2026-LH-23). Legal needs an export of his project artifacts and access logs before we terminate accounts. @lena can you confirm legal engagement?

lena (People Ops): Engaged Legal already. legal-bot will post next steps.

legal-bot: Legal hold acknowledged. Action items: 1) Snapshot repo `customer-matching` and S3 bucket `cust-data-prod` access logs; 2) Preserve Slack DM archive for user for 90 days; 3) Do not delete any artifacts until legal closes hold. Contact: legal@redwood.com.

ryan (Manager): I will make a list of all tickets and ownership transfers. Also flagging dependent oncall schedule 06/12-06/18 1 need temporary coverage.

noah (Eng): I'll handover runbooks and add inline comments in `customer-matching` by EOD 6/4.

mike (IT): For the snapshot: please tell me which repos need snapshots. I'll run `git bundle` and export S3 manifests. Need these by 6/11 12:00 PT to feed Legal.

hana (Security): I'll start scanning Vault for secrets owned by noah@redwood.com and open tickets to reassign. Expect list in ~4 hours.

chloe (Benefits): Payroll note: final paycheck run = next semi-monthly cycle (pay date 6/30). PTO payout included. If there are commissions/bonuses, submit paperwork to payroll by 6/15.

noah (Eng): I have two outstanding expenses (travel + hardware). I'll file expense claims today.

lena (People Ops): Noah1 please complete offboarding forms here: https://forms.internal/offboard (this creates asset ticket). Offboard-bot will follow up.

offboard-bot: Equipment ticket created: RX-4599. Reminder scheduled for asset return on 2026-06-12.

ryan (Manager): Quick question on staged access removal: can we keep read-only access to repos for 48hrs after deactivation for audit?

mike (IT): We can snapshot and provide read-only bundles, but live account read-only isn't supported post-Okta deactivation. We can provide `git bundle` and S3 tarballs for 30 days.

hana (Security): Also note: revoke any personal SSH keys tied to engineers accounts and rotate shared service credentials that Noah touched. I'll list affected services.

lena (People Ops): Legal asked to preserve Noah's Slack DMs for 90 days; we'll not purge. Offboarding sequence updated: legal exports -> snapshots -> disable accounts -> equipment return.

noah (Eng): Fine with that. One more: stock vesting/proration questions? Who to contact?

chloe (Benefits): Equity: final vesting/proration depends on plan; equity@redwood.com will send a summary. If there's post-termination exercise window changes, that'll be in equity email.

ryan (Manager): I'll draft the team announcement for 6/12 after Noah's last day; include KB links to KT notes and support contact.

lena (People Ops): Action items recap (I'll track):
- 6/02 & 6/03: KT sessions (Ryan + Noah)
- 6/04: Noah finishes runbook updates
- 6/11 18:00 PT: Okta/Slack deactivation (post-legal snapshot)
- 6/12: Equipment pickup / return label
- 6/30: final payroll run includes PTO
- COBRA packet emailed within 3 business days of termination

mike (IT): Noted. I'll schedule the snapshot for 6/11 09:00 PT to give Legal time.

hana (Security): Uploading secret owner list to ticket RX-4599 shortly.

noah (Eng): Thanks all. Appreciate the help making this smooth.

lena (People Ops): Thanks Noah. We'll update this thread as tasks complete. :thumbsup:
